subject: Intro + demo request: real-time helpdesk summarization
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@shelflab.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Intro + demo request: real-time helpdesk summarization

Hi Stephanie,

I signed up for the free trial this morning (account: shelflab-trial-221) and poked around the API — looks promising. We’re exploring Redwood as the inference backend for a real-time helpdesk summarization feature (short chat transcripts -> 1–2 sentence summaries + suggested tags).

Quick context:
- Team: Product + ML (2 PMs, 2 engineers)
- Expected steady-state: ~2M tokens/month (rough), with peak burst traffic around ~50 requests/sec during US business hours
- Avg prompt+response ~200 tokens
- Latency target: sub-200ms p50 for online summaries (would be nice to understand p95 tradeoffs)
- Timeline: pilot/internal demo in ~4–6 weeks; production roll by Q2 if things go well
- Preference: start on hosted API to move fast, but we may need Dedicated later for predictable throughput and data controls

Would love a short demo next week to see latency profiles, batching behavior, and deployment options. I’ve attached a tiny CSV with sample traffic (filename: shelflab-traffic-estimates.csv). Also happy to include a couple of stakeholders on the call — Priya (PM) will likely join.

Are you available for a 30-minute sync next week?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Torres
Head of ML, ShelfLab
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T10:05:00-08:00

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for signing up + sharing the sample traffic. I’m Stephanie (SDR, Redwood) — looping in Marissa (SE) so she can prep a short, focused demo.

Couple quick qualification questions so we make the session tactical:
- Confirmed success criteria for the pilot? (accuracy of summaries, latency, cost per 1k summaries, or other KPIs)
- Do you anticipate attachments / long transcripts (tokens > 1k) or mostly short chats (~200 tokens)?
- Any compliance needs (SAML/SSO, SOC2, data residency) we should be aware of for the demo?
- Who are the other stakeholders we should invite? (titles are fine)

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Tue 12/22 10:30–11:00am
- Wed 12/23 2:00–2:30pm
- Thu 12/24 9:00–9:30am

If none work, tell me a couple of windows and I’ll loop in Vivek (AE) and Marissa to adjust. Agenda idea: 10m quick product + perf profile, 10m traffic/ops questions, 10m next steps & pilot ask.

I’ve attached a short Redwood one-pager that summarizes deployment modes and typical SLAs (redwood-one-pager.pdf). Also here’s a booking link if you prefer to pick a time directly: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-demo-slot

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
SDR, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@shelflab.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T10:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request: real-time helpdesk summarization

Thanks Stephanie — that agenda looks perfect. Quick answers inline:
- Pilot success: p50 latency <200ms, p95 <500ms if possible; summaries reach human-grade usefulness (PM-reviewed) for 80% of sampled tickets; cost target TBD but want to understand cost tradeoffs
- Mostly short chats ~150–250 tokens; we have a small fraction (<5%) of longer transcripts (customer calls) that could be >1k tokens
- Compliance: SOC2 is required; SAML SSO later in the stack is desirable but not blocking for pilot
- Stakeholders: Priya Mehta (PM), Daniel Cook (Eng manager), maybe Jose (infra) if we look at Dedicated later

For slots, Wed 12/23 2:00pm PST works best for Priya & me. I can jump on that one if you confirm.

—Alex

If you need to reschedule, let us know and we’ll propose alternates. Looking forward to it.

Best,
